prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls & Interactions", "Try moving, hovering, and summoning your pet on your screen before launching to your desktop.", "Test Desktop Pet Hover"]
1: ["Your Companion is Hatching!", "Tap or hover near the pet shell while our server builds your custom desktop companion graphics."]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Animation Layers", "We are calibrating screen boundaries, tray icon shortcuts, and desktop movement logic.", "Configuring multi-monitor placement and taskbar compatibility..."]
3: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Control pet visibility anytime from your system tray or quick key shortcuts.", "Launch Desktop Pet", "Launch to Desktop"]
4: ["Save Your Adoption Certificate to Account", "Sign in now so your customized desktop pet and certificate remain safely synced to your profile."]
5: ["Choose Your Path & Unlock Unique Pet Badges", "Each path unlocks exclusive desktop behaviors and starter personality traits for your companion.", "Exclusive Starter Badge Unlocked"]
6: ["Review and Seal Your Pet Adoption", "Confirm your desktop pet name and traits before final generation begins.", "Finalize Adoption"]
7: ["Building Your Desktop Pet", "Track real-time generation milestones as your pet is finalized."]
8: ["System Tray & Desktop Controls Quick Guide", "Learn how to bring your pet to the front, minimize it while working, or open companion options.", "Got It, Start Pet!"]
9: ["Secure Your Pet & Prevent Data Loss", "Sign in to back up your desktop pet's growth, traits, and custom styling permanently to the cloud.", "Sign In to Protect Pet"]
